units.source_text: 匂亲王昨夜突然闯入，使得二女公子惊惶失措，

en.t: Prince Niou had suddenly forced his way in the night before, throwing the second young lady into panic and confusion,

units.source_text: 此时尚且觉得她的容颜姣美无比，

en.t: and even then he had thought her face incomparably beautiful,

units.source_text: 何况今夜她已变成一个柔顺的新妇，

en.t: so all the more now that tonight she had become a gentle and yielding bride,

units.source_text: 他对她的爱情越发加深了。

en.t: his love for her deepened still further.

units.source_text: 但想起了遥远的山路来往不便，

en.t: But when he thought of the distant mountain road and how inconvenient it was to come and go,

units.source_text: 心中不胜痛苦，

en.t: his heart was filled with unbearable pain,

units.source_text: 便怀着深挚的爱情，同她立下山盟海誓。

en.t: and with deep and earnest love, he exchanged solemn vows with her.

units.source_text: 二女公子一句话也不想听，

en.t: The second young lady did not want to hear a single word,

units.source_text: 毫无感动之色。

en.t: and showed no sign of being moved at all.

units.source_text: 无论何等娇生惯养的千金小姐，

en.t: No matter how pampered and delicately raised a noble young lady might be,

units.source_text: 倘是和普通人稍多接近、家有父母兄弟而见惯男子行动的人，

en.t: if she had had even a little contact with ordinary people, and had parents and brothers at home so that she was used to seeing how men behaved,

units.source_text: 则初次和男子相处时，其羞耻之情与恐惧之心总不会如此难堪。

en.t: then when she first spent time with a man, her shame and fear would surely not have been this painful to bear.

units.source_text: 可是我们这位二女公子，

en.t: But this second young lady of ours,

units.source_text: 倒并非由于在家中受到推崇和溺爱，

en.t: was not this way because she had been especially honored and spoiled at home,

units.source_text: 只因住在如此荒僻的山乡中，

en.t: but simply because she had lived in such a remote and desolate mountain village,

units.source_text: 故而性格不喜接近生人，

en.t: and so by nature she disliked drawing near to strangers,

units.source_text: 万事退缩不前。

en.t: shrinking back from everything and never stepping forward.

units.source_text: 如今突然与男子共处，

en.t: Now that she was suddenly spending time alone with a man,

units.source_text: 只觉得恐惧与羞耻。

en.t: she felt only fear and shame.

units.source_text: 她生怕自己一切都和世人不同，

en.t: She was afraid that everything about her was different from other people,

units.source_text: 显露出古怪的乡村陋相来，

en.t: and that she would reveal some strange, unsightly rustic awkwardness,

units.source_text: 因此一句答话也说不出口，

en.t: so she could not bring herself to utter even a single word in reply,

units.source_text: 只管提心吊胆。

en.t: and merely remained tense and frightened.

units.source_text: 然而她的品貌和才情，实比大女公子更强。

en.t: Yet in grace, beauty, and talent, she was in fact superior to the elder young lady.
